media.title: Media — Component Lab — Digital Treasury
media.desc: Five ways to present a body of work: an orbital carousel, a cylinder drum, a velocity-driven rail, a slice slider and a scrubbed gallery.

cards.title: Cards — Component Lab — Digital Treasury
cards.desc: Five ways to give a set of things unequal weight: a highlight accordion, a throw deck, a morphing bento, a scrubbed stack and a tilt grid.

testimonials.title: Testimonials — Component Lab — Digital Treasury
testimonials.desc: Five ways to make a testimonial section worth stopping for: an orbit, a leaning wall, a spotlight rail, a coverflow and a ledger.

cta.title: Call to action — Component Lab — Digital Treasury
cta.desc: Five ways to ask for the meeting: a honeycomb hive, a vault door on the scrollbar, an aurora plate, a drawn seal and a marquee stamp.

team.title: Team — Component Lab — Digital Treasury
team.desc: Three ways to introduce a team: an orbit with a focused centre, a ruled roster with the portrait on the pointer, and a helix of disciplines.

backgrounds.title: Backgrounds — Component Lab — Digital Treasury
backgrounds.desc: Seventeen procedural grounds, and six ways one scene arrives over the last: cover, curtain, iris, fold, slide and push — all scrubbed from the scrollbar.

scroll.title: Scroll — Component Lab — Digital Treasury
scroll.desc: Eight scroll set-pieces, one per section: gradient text, split screen, word cascade, horizontal pan, cinematic counter, depth flight, scroll rotation and a scroll-driven ticker.
